justification: The opening work is complete, coherent, and verified across all eight occupied storeys. All 220 doors and 366 windows are hosted, the opening check reports no findings, every occupied office-type room checked has exterior glazing, and the selected entrance, stair, lift, room-door, and window families are appropriately configured.
evidence: Live measurements found 586 openings total on storeys 1–8, with 586/586 hosted. The opening check reported zero findings on every floor; the clearance check passed with zero findings; the access check found 225 rooms and zero rooms without doors. Occupied-room daylight coverage was 18/18 on floors 1–5, 16/16 on floor 6, and 18/18 on floors 7–8. Window sills measured consistently at 0.894 m; heads were 2.706 m on floor 1 and 2.406 m on floors 2–8. Examples include a stair door with a 60-minute fire rating, a sliding lift door at 1.200 m nominal width, and an outward-opening 1.943 m main entrance.
strengths: Complete whole-building coverage: floor counts sum exactly to the claimed 220 doors and 366 windows.
Every occupied storey has room doors and exterior daylight coverage; no occupied office-type room in the eight-floor review lacked a window.
All 586 openings have real wall hosts, and the clearance check returned no failures.
Opening operations are suitable: room doors open into rooms, final exits open outside, lift landing doors slide, and fixed windows avoid unsafe inward sash movement.
Widths are appropriate: regular doors measure 1.029 m nominal, lift doors 1.200 m nominal, and pair doors 1.943 m nominal.
Stair doors use a Single Flush Door family, version 4, with a 60-minute fire rating set.
The main entrance uses a Pair Flush Door family, version 5, and opens outward; windows use the Fixed Window – 2 Panel family, version 6.
The agent's final counts and dimensional descriptions agree with live geometry within family/opening conventions.
